Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    # Reduce each separator-delimited tile by marking the location of its
    # sparse foreground color. Tile dimensions and separators vary by instance.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    from collections import Counter
    freq=Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in rs and j not in cs)
    mark=min(freq,key=freq.get); bg=max(freq,key=freq.get)
    return [[bg if sum(grid[i][j]==mark for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(x+1,y))==1 else 1 for x,y in zip(cb,cb[1:])] for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:])]
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divrows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    divcols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    from collections import Counter
    divider = grid[divrows[0]][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    rbounds = [-1] + divrows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + divcols + [w]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(a + 1, b) for c in range(x + 1, y)) > 1 else background
             for x, y in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:]) if y - x > 1]
            for a, b in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:]) if b - a > 1]
